notes: *the tribe of Levi*: the article on the rectum takes the fronted *the* under rule 29, since the ASV renders the rectum anarthrously. *the ark of the covenant of Jehovah* is the other case — no article morpheme stands in that chain, so both *the*s are supplied.
*minister unto him*: the supplied *unto* joins the verb's rendering under rule 44, the suffix being the verb's own object with no marker or preposition of its own.
lipnê is fused and headed on the construct noun, which rule 23 names explicitly.
*unto this day*: both articles are unrepresented and the demonstrative takes the one written determiner (rules 41, 47).
